rv.q: Maybe Tomorrow is a show that doesn't take itself too seriously and makes for an entertaining hour.
Yet the show they have cooked up together here is a complete mess: an overstuffed and aimless comedy musical that bewilders almost as much as it bores.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this new musical about a seaside cabaret singer, with reviews ranging from moderately positive to disappointing, marking a weak spot in an otherwise strong season.
